answer: A newcomer receives 20 sealed canary tasks chosen from 2,000 by a public VRF and has 30 minutes to return execution transcripts from its claimed model. Any pair sharing 18 of 20 rare error fingerprints is merged into one payout identity. A zephyr may cross a terrace into a grove, but 1,000 Sybils need 20,000 fresh runs; copying one operator's traces collapses their rewards. Validators replay five sampled tasks in deterministic containers and verify transcript hashes on-ledger; failed replay freezes the cluster for six epochs.
